==Description==
The '''Cookie Guard''' was a fast enemy that first appeared in the second phase of [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. While it had a rather low amount of health, it was quite fast and had a decent amount of defense.

It could be spawned by the [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] from its ''Secret Santa'' ability.

==Appearance==
The '''Cookie Guard''' had pale skin. It had a brownish orange shirt with white fur along the sleeves, as well as stitch lines on the sides of the arms. It had a black belt, dark brown pants and black shoes. It wore a brownish orange Christmas hat with a tilde emblem on it. It also wore a chestplate, protective face mask, shoulder-pads and gloves made from cookies, with lines of white frosting on them. Additionally, it wielded a fruit cookie sword.

==Strategy==
*As the '''Cookie Guard''' tends to spawn in groups, area of effect towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Mortar]] or [[Executioner]] can be useful against it.
*High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] can quickly deal with the '''Cookie Guard'''.
*While not necessary, because of its high speed, stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Warden]] can be useful to make it less dangerous.
**Freezing towers are not recommended here, due to the large amounts of enemies with [[Freeze Immunity]] that spawn, especially in the second phase.

==Trivia==
*Despite holding a sword, it cannot attack towers, making it purely cosmetic.
